rows: When was the first motor race?
Paris-Rouen, 1894 (reliability trial)
When did F1 championship begin?
1950, Silverstone, Giuseppe Farina wins
What was ground effect in F1?
Lotus 78/79 (1977-78): underfloor venturi tunnels create downforce -- banned 1983
What triggered F1 safety revolution?
Senna + Ratzenberger deaths, Imola 1994
When was Le Mans first run?
1923; annually (mostly) since
Who founded NASCAR?
Bill France Sr., December 1947, Daytona Beach
What triggered HANS device mandate?
Dale Earnhardt Sr. death, Daytona 2001
What was Group B WRC?
1983-86 era of ~600bhp rally cars; banned after 1986 deaths
Who has the most MotoGP titles?
Valentino Rossi: 9 (including last 500cc, first MotoGP era)
What is the Isle of Man TT?
Oldest motorcycle road race (1907); 37.73 miles on public roads; 260+ total deaths
Who designed the most F1 winners?
Adrian Newey (Williams FW14B, McLaren MP4/13, Red Bull RB series)
